bridge_rubric_anchor.s_prior_summary: Add, subtract, factor, and expand linear/algebraic expressions (7.EE.A.1) and rewrite expressions in different forms to shed light on a problem (7.EE.A.2).
bridge_rubric_anchor.s_target_summary: Locate the exact extremum of a quadratic relationship and justify why no input can exceed or fall below it (HSA-SSE.B.3.b).
bridge_rubric_anchor.score_0_boundary_miss: D1/D3 states x = -b/(2a) or gives the expression already in vertex form a(x - h)^2 + k.
bridge_rubric_anchor.score_1_loose_match: The maximum/minimum occurs at a listed integer table value where neighboring symmetric points are already shown.
bridge_rubric_anchor.score_2_exact_bridge: Students can evaluate or factor the expression at whole-number inputs (7.EE.A.1-2), find two symmetric inputs that tie while the true peak/trough lies between them, and must use symmetry or a squared-deviation form to pin down the exact extremum.
